# Also in actual dollars (since values are in thousands)
print(f"\nIn actual dollars (thousands * 1000):")
print(f"Projected September: ${y_sept*1000:,.0f}")
print(f"Final result: ${result*1000:,.0f}")
print(f"Rounded final: {round(result*1000)}")

    n = len(A)
    M = [A[i][:] + [B[i]] for i in range(n)]
